 Small Is the Man Who Leads to Sal-Vation 
 by Michael Baumann 
 October 25, 2026 
 Matt Marton-Imagn Images 
 MILWAUKEE — In the bottom of the sixth inning of Game 2 of the World Series , Brewers right fielder Sal Frelick dug in against Rays reliever Ian Seymour with his team trailing by a run. 
 Seymour’s first pitch, a sinker, landed right in the middle of the zone for a called strike one.
 The Brewers had trailed 4-0 in this game before they’d even come to the plate, but they’d been in this position before.
